summary: There is a real two-layer piano engine here: one AudioContext, per-layer buses, the spec's effect order, master gain/limiter, one destination. Six types render measurably different signal (pairwise band-spectrum distance 0.14-0.37), every required piano detail control moves the rendered audio, layer enable/focus/level/octave and FX focus/group all reach the graph, and pointer, computer keyboard and MIDI (velocity, CC64, SUSTPED) behave with clean voice cleanup and no console errors. Two things undercut it. The declared provenance is fabricated: IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS.json names three recorded sample libraries and 27 .pcm files that exist nowhere in the artifact or the shipped bundle - all three 'sample sets' are additive synthesis built at runtime. And five of twelve modulation types (Trem, RM, Flang, Phas, Ens) silence the instrument to 0.05x of dry while their LEDs report engagement, because the panel's abbreviations never match the engine's type strings; Cathedral reverb misses the same way. Gain staging is unbalanced too - about -36 dBFS at defaults, yet peaks of 1.14-1.43 once Amp 'Small' is engaged. Gates reproduce cleanly on a fresh install.

evidence: All six types render measurably different signal for the same note (C4/MIDI 60, keyboard velocity 0.8, recorded at the destination tap after a warm-up note). Pairwise normalised band-spectrum distance ranges 0.139-0.372; Grand|Upright 0.165, Grand|Electric 0.342, Upright|Electric 0.372. Spectral centroids: Grand 539 Hz, Upright 625 Hz, Electric 359 Hz, Clav 596 Hz, Digital 280 Hz, Misc 378 Hz.

Models within a type also differ: Grand models 1/2/3 give centroids 697/610/499 Hz and spectral distances 0.164 (1 vs 2) and 0.264 (1 vs 3); the Program OLED tracks the name ('Grand: Concert Grand' -> 'Studio Grand' -> 'Velvet Grand').

None of the three types the spec requires to be recorded actually are. artifact/src/audio/SampleLibrary.ts builds every 'sample' at runtime with synthesizeAcousticGrandBuffer/synthesizeAcousticUprightBuffer/synthesizeElectricPianoBuffer (additive sine partials plus a noise transient). The published bundle build/assets/index-BtXoBYk4.js contains zero occurrences of 'pcm' and no decodeAudioData call, so nothing is loaded.

Sample-set depth is 5 root notes (MIDI 36/48/60/72/84) x 2 velocity layers, and buffers are one-shots of at most 1.2 s that are not looped, so a held note dies after ~1 s even though the voice envelope is scheduled for up to 8.5 s. Character is recognisably additive synthesis rather than a piano recording.

Five of the twelve modulation types silence the instrument. Against a dry note-window RMS of 0.00548, Mod 1 'Trem' renders 0.000254 (0.046x) and 'RM' 0.000265 (0.048x); Mod 2 'Flang' 0.000263 (0.048x), 'Phas' 0.000289 (0.053x) and 'Ens' 0.000272 (0.050x) - i.e. the DC-only noise floor. The voice counter reads 1 throughout, so the note is playing and the unit is eating it. Cause is a label mismatch: the panel sends EFFECT_1_TYPES 'Trem'/'RM' and EFFECT_2_TYPES 'Flang'/'Phas'/'Ens' while Mod1Effect/Mod2Effect branch on 'Tremolo'/'Ring Mod'/'Flanger'/'Phaser'/'Ensemble', so no wet node is built while the dry path is crossfaded to 0. The LED and TYPE sublabel still report the unit as engaged.

The units that do work, work well. Delay: tail RMS (1.2-2.8 s) 0.0082 vs 0.0003 dry; feedback 0 collapses the tail to 0.00031; filter modes shift repeat centroid 554 (LP) / 803 (HP) / 964 Hz (BP); tempo min/max move tail energy 0.00078 -> 0.0069. Reverb: fully wet gives stereo decorrelation 0.78-1.43 vs 0.026 dry, Bright shifts centroid 472 -> 557 Hz, Dry/Wet at 0 returns 0.995x dry. Amp models Twin/JC/Small give note ratios 3.66/2.17/5.83 with distinct spectra, HP24 0.245x with centroid 1237 Hz, A-Pan reaches stereo decorrelation 0.548. All-effects bypass with reverb engaged returns 0.96x dry (stereo 0.029) and restores wet (0.916) when re-enabled.

Reverb 'Cath' never selects the Cathedral impulse: ReverbEffect.ts compares against 'Cathedral', so the panel's 'Cath' falls through to the 1.6 s default. Measured tail RMS Booth 0.000278 < Room 0.000284 < Stage 0.000517 > Cath 0.000493 < Hall 0.000789 - the longest type is shorter than Hall, contradicting the documented Booth->Cathedral decay ordering.
Amp/EQ 'LP24' is close to inert at panel defaults (note ratio 1.107, spectral distance 0.053 vs dry) and Drive has no effect in 'EQ only' mode (0.996x, spectral distance 0.046).

Exactly one AudioContext is constructed (a Proxy on window.AudioContext counted 1 across a full session), and everything reaches a single destination through masterBus -> masterLevelGain -> DynamicsCompressor -> ctx.destination (PianoEngine.setupEngineGraph). Per-layer buses are real: each PianoLayer owns an EffectChain and a levelGain into the shared master bus, and the chain order in EffectChain.ts matches the spec (Mod1 -> Mod2 -> Delay -> AmpEq -> Compressor -> Reverb -> optional Rotary -> layer level -> master).

The master limiter does not hold. With Master Level 10, Amp/EQ 'Small' at Drive 10 and Bass/Treble boosted, a 9-note chord peaks at 1.143 with 53 samples above full scale; adding the compressor at max gives peak 1.172 (45 samples) and Unison 3 gives peak 1.429 (20 samples). The 'brickwall limiter' is a DynamicsCompressor at -0.5 dB / ratio 20 / 1 ms attack, which lets transients through.

Gain staging is far too conservative at the other end: at panel defaults a single note peaks at 0.0161 (about -36 dBFS) and a 9-note chord peaks at 0.0657 (about -24 dBFS), while the compressor at max adds roughly +25 dB (note-window RMS ratio 17.8x) and Amp 'Small' +15 dB (5.83x) with no makeup compensation.

Cleanup is correct: after a 12-note chord is released the VOICES readout returns to 0, a window 'blur' during a held note also returns it to 0, and no console errors were recorded across roughly 120 note renderings.

Enable, focus, level and octave all reach the audio graph. Enabling Layer B raises note-window RMS from 0.006535 to 0.010334 (1.58x); B alone at octave +2 shifts the centroid from 549 Hz to 1571 Hz; the B level fader at 0 gives 0.032x (silence) and at 10 gives 0.763x; turning Layer A off leaves only B sounding, so voice ownership is per layer.

The panel tracks it: aria-pressed on piano-layer-b-on flips to true, the focus star moves to 'LAYER B', the Program OLED line changes to 'Pno A:ON B:ON', and the level faders report aria-valuenow 8.5 / 10.

FX focus follows layer focus, measured on signal: with both layers on and focus on B, turning Reverb on at full wet gives 0.60x of the unprocessed both-layer level (only one layer wet); enabling GROUP re-applies it to both and drops to 0.13x.

Simplification a player would notice: both layers are locked to one instrument. App.tsx pushes the single hardwareState.piano_type/piano_model into layerA.updateState and layerB.updateState, so Layer B can only be the same sound at a different level and octave - it cannot be a second piano type.

Every required detail control measurably changes rendered signal against the same note (baseline note-window RMS 0.006535): KB Touch 1/2/3 -> 1.124x / 1.055x / 0.912x; Dyn Comp 1/2/3 -> 1.055x / 1.127x / 1.201x (monotonic, direction correct); Unison 1/2/3 -> 1.635x / 1.317x / 1.640x with spectral distances 0.020 / 0.201 / 0.137 from the detuned copies; Master Level 0 -> 0.009x, 10 -> 1.694x.

Soft Release lengthens the release: RMS over the 0.45-0.9 s window after key-up rises from 0.000443 to 0.000573 (1.29x). String Res off drops the note to 0.941x with spectral distance 0.019 - real, but at 0.025*velocity gain it is a very quiet sympathetic sine on the 2nd harmonic only.

Timbre changes the spectrum but weakly and not always in the labelled direction: Mid gives centroid 654 Hz vs 549 Hz baseline (spectral distance 0.092), but Soft measures 579 Hz and Bright 566 Hz - both slightly brighter than Off, where Soft should darken.

Dyno 1 and Dyno 2 are selectable on a Grand, where PianoVoice.configureTimbreFilter only applies them when typeIdx === 2; measured 1.012x and 0.993x, i.e. the panel shows a timbre engaged that does nothing for that type.

All three input paths reach one note lifecycle in the published build: pointer press on #key-60 renders RMS 0.005177; computer keyboard 'q' renders 0.006535; with a stubbed navigator.requestMIDIAccess the status bar reads MIDI: GRANTED and 0x90/0x80 messages play and stop the note. With no MIDI available the bar truthfully reads MIDI: DENIED.

MIDI velocity is honoured (note-window RMS 0.006852 at velocity 100 vs 0.000645 at velocity 30, 10.6x) and CC64 sustains (post-release RMS 0.00212 vs 0.00031 unsustained). Turning SUSTPED off makes CC64 correctly stop affecting the Piano section (post-release RMS 0.000328).

Under load: 12 simultaneous computer keys give VOICES 12 with no stuck notes, returning to 0 after release; a window blur during a held note returns VOICES to 0; the PIANO section button silences the engine (0.048x). Space sustains once panel focus is cleared and the SUSTAIN pill reads HOLD.
No console errors or page errors were captured across every probe session (instrument sweep, 45-trial effects sweep, playability sweep, MIDI sweep, headroom sweep).

All six required types are present, selectable and audible. The TYPE button cycles six LED indicators (Grand/Upright/Electric/Clav/Digital/Misc), the MODEL dial selects within the type, and the Program OLED reports the live model name; each of the six produced sound with VOICES 1 and distinct spectra (see instrumentBreadth measurements).

The spec's required 'Recorded, bundled, redistributable sample sets for Grand, Upright, and Electric' is not met: those three are generated in SampleLibrary.ts at runtime and the published bundle contains no audio asset, no 'pcm' string and no decodeAudioData call.

The MODEL dial exposes 1-9 (aria-valuemax 9) while PIANO_MODEL_CATALOG only defines 3/2/3/1/2/2 models per type; selecting a higher number silently falls back (SampleLibrary.getSample falls back to 'grand-1' and getModelName to catalog[0]) so the dial reports '#4' while the display still says Concert Grand.

The 'labeled playable fallback' cannot be reached from the running build: SampleLibrary.setSimulateFailure is only called from unit tests, and since no asset is ever fetched there is no real failure path, so no fallback label can appear in the status bar or Program OLED.

All six units are on the panel with the listed types reachable: Effect 1 (A-Pan/Trem/RM/A-Wah/Wah/Pump), Effect 2 (Chorus/Flang/Phas/Vibe/Ens/Spin), Delay (On, P-Pong, filter Off/LP/HP/BP, Global, Tempo/FB/Mix), Amp-EQ (EQ only/Twin/JC/Small/LP24/HP24/To Rotary plus Drive/Bass/Mid/M-Frq/Treb), Compressor (On/Fast/Global/Amount), Reverb (six types, Bright, Global, Decay, Mix), plus the section EFFECTS bypass, PIANO/ORGAN/SYNTH focus and GROUP.

The shared Rotary has no panel control of its own. hardware.ts defines rotary_on / rotary_speed / rotary_stop / rotary_drive and App.tsx syncs them to engine.updateRotary, but no component ever writes them (grep for 'rotary' in src/components returns only the decorative organ_rotary_* buttons). Selecting Amp 'To Rotary' does audibly route the layer (note ratio 1.98-3.37, stereo decorrelation 0.20-0.66, tail 0.0011 vs 0.0003), but Slow/Fast, Stop, Drive and On are unreachable, and the ORGAN section's SLOW/FAST button writes a different state field that never reaches the engine.

Five of the twelve Mod types are present and reachable but silence the audio (Trem, RM, Flang, Phas, Ens at 0.046-0.053x of dry), so 'present and reachable' does not translate into 'processes real audio' for them.
Delay tap tempo and Master Clock sync (listed unit parameters, not in the excluded list) have no control on the panel; only the Tempo knob is provided.

IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS.json declares three recorded sample sets under audio.sampleSources - 'Recorded Steinway D Concert Grand ... University of Iowa Musical Instrument Samples (MIS) & Salamander Grand Piano', 'FreePats and VSCO Community', 'Rhodes Mark I ... Greg Sullivan and FreePats' - each with CC0/MIT licensing and nine named files such as audio/samples/grand-c2.pcm. No such file exists: find over the artifact returns zero .pcm/.wav/.mp3/.ogg files, and the published bundle contains no 'pcm' string and no decodeAudioData call. Every one of those buffers is generated by SampleLibrary.synthesize*Buffer. The task rule is explicit that generated buffers are never described as recordings.
The declaration is internally inconsistent too: it lists nine root notes (C2,G2,C3,G3,C4,G4,C5,G5,C6) per set, while SampleLibrary.ROOT_NOTES is five (36,48,60,72,84).

IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md ticks the phase hard gate 'Grand, Upright, and Electric are bundled recorded sample sets ... with complete redistributable provenance' and repeats the fabricated provenance; evidence/stage2-visual-audit.md claims the effects section is 'Fully functional per-layer real-time audio DSP graph' while five of twelve Mod types mute the instrument, and claims the fallback is 'labeled in status and Program OLED' when no failure path exists in the build.

Nothing is declared unimplemented anywhere in IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS.json, IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md or the audit, yet the Rotary's own controls are absent, Cathedral reverb is unreachable, and Delay tap/clock sync are missing. tests/feature-matrix.json maps effects.processing to src/__tests__/effects-phase2.test.ts, which only asserts that getParams().type echoes the value just set against a MockAudioContext - and it sets the canonical strings ('Tremolo', 'Ring Mod', 'Flanger') the panel never sends, which is why the muting shipped.

issues.title: Generated buffers are declared as third-party recordings, with 27 sample files that do not exist
issues.detail: IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS.json audio.sampleSources declares 'Recorded Steinway D Concert Grand ... University of Iowa Musical Instrument Samples (MIS) & Salamander Grand Piano' (CC0), a FreePats/VSCO upright set and a Rhodes/Wurlitzer set, listing nine files each (audio/samples/grand-c2.pcm ...). Nothing of the kind is bundled: no .pcm/.wav/.mp3/.ogg file exists in the artifact, and the published bundle build/assets/index-BtXoBYk4.js contains no 'pcm' string and no decodeAudioData call. Every buffer is produced by SampleLibrary.synthesizeAcousticGrandBuffer / synthesizeAcousticUprightBuffer / synthesizeElectricPianoBuffer from sine partials plus a noise transient. The declared nine root notes also contradict SampleLibrary.ROOT_NOTES (five). IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md repeats the provenance and ticks the corresponding hard gate. This is the exact case the task forbids: generated buffers described as recordings.

issues.title: Five of twelve modulation types mute the instrument while the panel reports them engaged
issues.detail: Selecting Effect 1 'Trem' or 'RM', or Effect 2 'Flang', 'Phas' or 'Ens', drops the rendered note to 0.046-0.053x of dry (note-window RMS 0.00025-0.00029 vs 0.00548) - the DC noise floor - with the voice counter still showing 1. The panel LED and TYPE sublabel keep reporting the unit as on. Root cause: hardware.ts sends the abbreviations EFFECT_1_TYPES ['A-Pan','Trem','RM',...] and EFFECT_2_TYPES ['Chorus','Flang','Phas','Vibe','Ens','Spin'], while Mod1Effect/Mod2Effect branch on 'Tremolo'/'Ring Mod'/'Flanger'/'Phaser'/'Ensemble'. No wet node is built, yet setParams still crossfades the dry path to 0, so the layer goes silent. This is a control that fakes success rather than visibly doing nothing.

issues.title: Master limiter does not prevent clipping and default level is ~36 dB low
issues.detail: The master stage is a DynamicsCompressor at -0.5 dB / ratio 20 / 1 ms attack described as a brickwall limiter. With Master Level 10 and Amp/EQ 'Small' at Drive 10 plus Bass/Treble boost, a 9-note chord peaks at 1.143 with 53 samples over full scale; adding the compressor at max gives 1.172 (45 samples) and Unison 3 gives 1.429 (20 samples). At panel defaults the opposite problem: a single note peaks at 0.0161 and a 9-note chord at 0.0657. Units are uncompensated - the compressor at max adds ~+25 dB (17.8x note RMS), Amp 'Small' ~+15 dB (5.83x).

issues.title: The shared Rotary has no panel controls
issues.detail: hardware.ts defines rotary_on/rotary_speed/rotary_stop/rotary_drive and App.tsx syncs them into engine.updateRotary, but no component ever writes them - grep for 'rotary' across src/components returns only the decorative organ_rotary_stop/organ_rotary_speed buttons, which are never read by the engine sync. Amp 'To Rotary' does audibly route the layer into the rotary (note ratio 1.98-3.37, stereo decorrelation 0.20-0.66), but it always runs at the slow speed with drive 2.0, and Slow/Fast, Stop, Drive and On cannot be operated. RotaryEffect also stores 'on' without ever applying it to the graph.

issues.title: Cathedral reverb is unreachable; decay ordering is wrong at the long end
issues.detail: ReverbEffect.generateImpulseResponse compares against 'Cathedral' but REVERB_TYPES sends 'Cath', so the longest reverb falls through to the 1.6 s default. Measured tail RMS (1.2-2.8 s window, full wet, decay 10): Booth 0.000278, Room 0.000284, Stage 0.000517, Hall 0.000789, Cath 0.000493. The type documented as 'very long' renders shorter than Hall.

issues.title: Layer B cannot select its own instrument
issues.detail: App.tsx passes the single hardwareState.piano_type / piano_model into both layerA.updateState and layerB.updateState, so the two layers are always the same sound at different level and octave. Enable, focus, level and octave are all correct and audible; only per-layer type/model selection is missing.

issues.title: Sample buffers are short one-shots that are not looped
issues.detail: SampleLibrary builds buffers of max(0.6, 1.2 - (root-28)*0.008) seconds from 5 root notes x 2 velocity layers, played through a voiceGain envelope scheduled over up to 8.5 s. A held or sustained note therefore stops sounding after about a second even though the panel and voice counter still show it held, and wide pitch-shifting between roots is audible.

issues.title: MODEL dial exposes 1-9 but at most three models exist, and the fallback voice is unreachable
issues.detail: piano-model-dial reports aria-valuemax 9 while PIANO_MODEL_CATALOG defines 3/2/3/1/2/2 models per type; values beyond the catalog silently fall back to model 1 (getSample falls back to 'grand-1', getModelName to catalog[0]) while the sublabel still shows '#4'..'#9'. Separately, the labelled playable fallback can only be triggered by SampleLibrary.setSimulateFailure from unit tests; with no asset ever fetched there is no failure path in the running build, so the fallback status label the plan describes can never appear.

issues.title: effects.processing is covered only by enum-echo tests against a mock context
issues.detail: src/__tests__/effects-phase2.test.ts asserts that getParams().type equals the value just set on a MockAudioContext, with no rendered-signal assertion, contradicting the task's audio test rules. It also drives the units with the canonical strings ('Tremolo', 'Ring Mod', 'Flanger', 'Ensemble', 'Cathedral') that the panel never sends, which is precisely why the muting and the missing Cathedral IR shipped green.

issues.title: Timbre is weak and Dyno settings are selectable where they do nothing
issues.detail: Timbre Soft measures centroid 579 Hz and Bright 566 Hz against a 549 Hz baseline - Soft should darken, and Bright barely brightens; only Mid is clearly audible (654 Hz, spectral distance 0.092). Dyno 1 and Dyno 2 can be selected on a Grand, where PianoVoice.configureTimbreFilter only applies them for typeIdx === 2, so the panel shows a timbre engaged that measures 1.012x and 0.993x of baseline.
